name: The Internet
description: The internet from ARPANET to the web, browsers, search engines, social media and cryptocurrency.

checkpoints.name: ARPANET
checkpoints.note: The first computer network links American universities in 1969. Packet switching and email are invented.

checkpoints.name: Email, Usenet and bulletin boards
checkpoints.note: TCP/IP joins networks into one internet. People meet on Usenet and bulletin boards, and the domain names we use today begin.

checkpoints.name: The World Wide Web
checkpoints.note: Tim Berners-Lee invents the web, Mosaic and Netscape make it easy to browse, Microsoft fights Netscape in the first browser war, and Google begins.

checkpoints.name: Social networks
checkpoints.note: Broadband arrives, Wikipedia and YouTube are founded and MySpace and Facebook begin social networking. Firefox challenges Internet Explorer.

checkpoints.name: Phones, apps and Bitcoin
checkpoints.note: Chrome, Twitter, Instagram and WhatsApp move the internet to the phone. Bitcoin, the first cryptocurrency, is launched, and Chrome becomes the most used browser.

checkpoints.name: Always online
checkpoints.note: TikTok and short video take over, cryptocurrency reaches the mainstream with booms and crashes, and AI chatbots begin to change how people search.
